The Lenfest Institute grows landmark program with expanded OpenAI support
digest.tldr: OpenAI is expanding the Lenfest AI Collaborative and Fellowship Program with $5 million in funding and up to $5 million in software credits and engineering support.

digest.title: Florida seeks a ban on ChatGPT acting like a person
digest.tldr: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier is calling for a judge to block OpenAI from "giving ChatGPT false human attributes," a few months after Florida sued the AI company over safety concerns.
